versions.name: Electricity
versions.description: Wire simple circuits, build an electromagnet and a rheostat, read a household meter, find an overloaded branch circuit, and rescue and treat someone who has taken a shock.

provenance.notes: Introduction year (and BSA number where absent) backfilled from the USSSP merit badge history table; for a renamed badge this is when THIS name took effect, not when the lineage began.
